english.note: Choose this when you need a noun for the feeling itself; everyday speech more often uses a stative expression meaning “not happy.”

examples.english: Long-term stress caused a lot of unhappiness to build up inside them.
examples.traditional: 長期受壓令佢心中積聚咗不少不快。
